method: Public read-only content fetch; when initial folk.ntnu.no/<site>/ did not respond, checked https://<site>.folk.ntnu.no/. No credentials, no account access; not an assurance of full site content.
interpretation: HTTP 410 is an observed server response, not evidence the owner deleted a site. Timeouts/empty content are INCONCLUSIVE. Source URLs remain preserved and clickable. Results become stale after the observation date.

laos.mirroredAssets: All three v2 PDF copies and welcome image already SHA-256 verified in CI; individual upstream PDFs were not re-fetched by this check.
